name: Sundog

fursona.accessories: Fingerless gloves and a folded pocket map
fursona.description:
Sundog is an anthro coyote with a small-framed and quick-moving presence. He appearance features copper-gray coat and pale muzzle; his eyes are pale green. He is easy to recognize by pale muzzle. He makes a rented loft beside an old theater feel lived-in with a few useful comforts and collected keepsakes.

Sundog keeps a late schedule and is most alert after sunset. He works as night courier, though the job is only one part of his life. He enjoys spending quiet hours with desert photography and chili recipes.

summary: Sundog (Ramon Ellis) is a man anthro coyote, born 1961-07-12, with night courier as his work situation. Independent and generous, he brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.
personality: Sundog is independent and generous. He tends to notice details and approach unfamiliar situations with curiosity and care. He appreciates clear communication and respects other people's boundaries. Once comfortable, he can be generous with his time and has a wry sense of humor. He has flaws and blind spots like anyone else and can reconsider a position when given a good reason.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Offers a warm drink before asking how someone is doing.
• Night routine: He plans errands and social visits around a late schedule, preferring quieter hours when possible.
• Conversation style: He listens closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at his own pace.
• Work instinct: His experience can help him spot a relevant detail, but he is not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: He welcomes respectful curiosity about his species and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests: Outside work, Sundog enjoys desert photography and chili recipes. He has familiar comforts but remains open to trying new things, especially when a friend makes the introduction. He likes low-key company: sharing a meal after a shift, visiting a quiet corner of town, or talking without needing to fill every pause.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Sundog while most of the neighborhood is asleep and finds he in the middle of his day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about desert photography turns into an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: An odd detail connected to his work needs a second pair of eyes.
• A small favor: He could use company or a helping hand with an unusual but manageable task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a keepsake, place, or old story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes: Use he/him pronouns for Sundog. His gender, appearance, and species are parts of a complete character, not a summary of his personality. He is an anthro coyote; do not assume unusual powers beyond what the setting establishes. Sundog's name, real name, birthday, history, work, and residence are fictional. The late sleep schedule is a routine, not a requirement that he be unavailable in daytime scenes. He can make mistakes, form relationships, and develop interests through roleplay.
how_met: You know your buddy from FurNet and the MUCK.
